provider: F1 published topography with Bahrain operator 2019 grade limits
vertical_datum: Relative to the published profile minimum; absolute diagram altitude is not used.
interpolation: Original registered F1 profile outside native560–800m and3160–3950m. Local monotone Hermite controls respect operator3.60% uphill/5.60% downhill bounds; endpoint slopes match the retained profile. Dense1m local controls avoid raster-like pitch steps.
method: Read relative heights from the published numerical extremum labels and drawn trace, then register individual official corners to retained native centerline geometry using FIA maps. Intermediate heights are graphical estimates, not measurements.
registration_notes: The old GLO-90 maximum was near T13. The operator and F1 diagram identify T4 as the summit. F1 gives 16.9 m relief, while the operator rounds the venue relief to18m. Relative heights only; the chart absolute sea-level datum is not used.
supersedes: Coarse GLO-90 road profile remains retained as source evidence, not as the racing deck. No new lidar or survey is claimed.
controls_note: Dense final native profile samples after PCHIP reconstruction; source_controls_m retains sparse diagram registration.

operator_grade_corrections.source_conflict: F 1 gives 16.9 m relative relief; the operator rounds this to 18 m. Preserve 16.9 m rather than scale the whole lap. The old unconstrained Hermite ramps reached 3.90% after T 2 and 4.86% before T 12, above the more specific operator maximum.
operator_grade_corrections.method: Spread the climb through the observed road approach instead of adding a steep cubic bulge between sparse graphical labels. T 11 and T 12 heights stay within 1 m of the earlier graphical estimates; the highest T 4 anchor and other sectors are unchanged.
operator_grade_corrections.survey_status: Local ramp positions and intermediate heights are estimates constrained by primary metric bounds, not a civil survey.

registered_controls_note: Canonical reconstructed heights at the original F1 graphical anchor stations. The primary operator maximum-gradient limits supersede conflicting intermediate sketch estimates within the declared±1m chart uncertainty. source_controls_m remains the unmodified graphical evidence. These registered heights are reconstruction controls, not newly measured or surveyed source values.
